verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own REST API is documented to set up and manage pipelines programmatically. Its Connector SDK ships AI coding-agent plugins (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) to build, test, and deploy connectors from natural-language prompts. The official MCP server can unlock write operations and copy connections with their configs. However, the evidence never shows a coding agent creating a destination, connection, and transformations and then triggering a sync end to end, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end headless pipeline creation and run-triggering via API/CLI, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline setup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a coding agent can scaffold, configure, and run a complete pipeline headlessly through the CLI or API

citations.quote: Set up and scale your data pipeline, and manage your Fivetran account programmatically using the Fivetran REST API.

We provide AI coding agent plugins that add Connector SDK-specific skills to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI. These skills let you build, test, and deploy connectors using natural language prompts.
Set `FIVETRAN_SCOPE` to `read/write` or `read/write/delete` to unlock write and delete operations
Transformations are automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule.
